top_cards.boundary: The ambient construction is only a proof engine after projection and multiplicity are paid.
top_cards.breaker: Show the target projection has unbounded multiplicity, the loss grows like the surplus, the constants are chosen after the limit, or the target packet has no ambient surplus fiber.
entry_conditions: A hard target may be easier after lifting to an auxiliary ambient representation.
The lifted proof must show surplus choices beat all loss/quotient costs before projecting back.
The target claim depends on preserving a concrete target-side invariant under projection, not on ambient abundance alone.
top_cards.name: Surplus-Loss Projection Certificate
required_output: 7-row certificate table: target, lift, surplus, loss budget, projection, target-size bound, breaker.
One inequality showing surplus beats all losses after constants are fixed, or one missing-surplus slot.
One boundary sentence forbidding ambient authority as target proof.
steps: Name the target object and the ambient lifted object.
State the surplus lower bound in the ambient representation.
State every loss, quotient, denominator, or bad-class budget.
State the projection back to the target and its injectivity or finite-multiplicity receipt.
Fix constants and selection rules before the limiting process.
State the target-size upper bound or packing bound used to convert ambient surplus into target exponent/decision gain.
Name a target-domain packet that would break the certificate.
top_cards.stop_update_rule: Do not claim target progress from a lift until surplus, loss, and projection receipts are all present with constants fixed before the limit and a target-size bound paid.

top_cards.boundary: The analogy is only a generator of target-side receipt obligations; it is never evidence for the imported claim by itself.
top_cards.breaker: Find an invariant that holds in the source frame but fails in the target frame, or show the mapped object lacks a target-side receipt.
entry_conditions: A move is imported from another field, representation, or formal frame.
The imported move must change the target-side evidence path, not just rename the residual.
top_cards.name: Analogy-to-Receipt Transfer Audit
required_output: One target-side receipt or explicit missing-receipt slot.
One transfer falsifier tied to the target domain.
One decision rule saying what changes if the receipt passes or fails.
One boundary sentence forbidding source-domain authority as evidence.
steps: Name the source frame and target frame.
Map source objects to target objects.
List invariants that must survive transfer.
Compile the analogy into a target-side receipt: theorem, gate, workbench check, formal field, or falsifier.
Name the decision consequence: proceed, kill as recurrence, or narrow to a missing primitive.
top_cards.stop_update_rule: Do not spend another analogy step unless it produced a target-side receipt, a falsifier, or a narrowed missing primitive.
